Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side), PDF page 12: the slip of [[Master Luke (V) (Virtual Block 3) (Errata 2)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints the restored Virtual Block 3 text (“[Pilot] 2. During battle, may use 2 Force to place an opponent's alien (except Jabba or a Rep) present with Luke on owner's Force Pile (opponent may use or lose 3 Force instead). Immune to attrition < 4 (< 7 if with an alien leader).”), word for word the text of [[Master Luke (V) (Virtual Block 3)]].<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Master List (Light Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
